quotes.text: @returns {string} HTML for a self-contained success page.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The listener starts an async success or error page generator, responds in then and only logs catch errors. It separately dispatches finishAuthorizationRequest and onAuthorizationReceived. The shown rejection path does not emit a fallback response and is not awaited by that completion dispatch. Generator JSDoc says string even though the async API resolves HTML markup; an accurate caller contract should describe that promise and its completion. This is a bounded static error/completion finding, not a reproduced stalled browser or failed login.
title: OAuth page generation rejection is logged outside the authorization completion chain
